name: Bake from a ratio
short_description: Scale and bake a simple formula from ingredient ratios, producing a consistent result twice.
self_assessment: I can scale one baking ratio and produce the intended result twice without help.
description: Scale and bake a simple formula from ingredient ratios, producing a consistent result twice.
